room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; proportionate deduction applies if higher room chosen

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day; ICU charges not subject to proportionate deduction

copayment.note: 20% co-pay applies to every claim; waiver available if optional add-on premium is paid

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹40k/eye; Modern Tx 50% SI; AYUSH 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern Treatments capped at 50% of SI; AYUSH capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disability covered after 24 months; all other pre-existing conditions (excluding HIV/AIDS) after 48 months

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, varicose veins etc. have 24-month waiting period

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days from discharge

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of 537 day-care procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to 50% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured and related complications explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of Sum Insured as inpatient or day care

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded under Annexure II List I

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for annual premium; 15-day grace for instalment modes

free_look.note: Free-look period of 15 days from receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only

portability.note: Portability to same product of other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; migration within company also allowed but only on product withdrawal

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, organ donation, domiciliary hospitalisation, ART for HIV, prosthetics/devices for disability, STDs, stem cell storage, alternative therapies (acupuncture etc.)
optional_riders: Co-pay waiver (optional add-on to remove 20% co-payment)
